mapper.select: SELECT t.session_key AS sessionKey, m.chat_id AS chatId, m.from_user_id AS fromUserId, m.to_user_id AS toUserId, m.goods_id AS goodsId, g.goods_name AS goodsName, g.price AS goodsPrice, m.content AS lastContent, m.message_type AS lastType, m.create_time AS lastTime, t.unread AS unread, CASE WHEN m.from_user_id = #{userId} THEN m.to_user_id ELSE m.from_user_id END AS otherUserId, u.username AS otherUserName, gi.image_url AS imageUrl FROM ( SELECT session_key, MAX(chat_id) AS last_id, SUM(CASE WHEN to_user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unread FROM chat_message WHERE from_user_id = #{userId} OR to_user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY session_key ) t JOIN chat_message m ON m.chat_id = t.last_id LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.user_id = (CASE WHEN m.from_user_id = #{userId} THEN m.to_user_id ELSE m.from_user_id END) LEFT JOIN goods g ON g.goods_id = m.goods_id LEFT JOIN goods_image gi ON gi.image_id = ( SELECT image_id FROM goods_image WHERE goods_id = m.goods_id ORDER BY is_primary DESC, sort_order ASC, image_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) ORDER BY m.chat_id DESC

SELECT m.chat_id AS chatId, m.from_user_id AS fromUserId, m.to_user_id AS toUserId, m.goods_id AS goodsId, m.content AS content, m.message_type AS messageType, m.related_id AS relatedId, m.is_read AS isRead, m.create_time AS createTime, o.order_status AS orderStatus, og.goods_name AS orderGoodsName, og.price AS orderPrice, o.create_time AS orderCreateTime, bu.username AS orderBuyerName, su.username AS orderSellerName FROM chat_message m LEFT JOIN orders o ON m.message_type = 'order' AND o.order_id = m.related_id LEFT JOIN goods og ON o.goods_id = og.goods_id LEFT JOIN `user` bu ON o.buyer_id = bu.user_id LEFT JOIN `user` su ON o.seller_id = su.user_id WHERE m.session_key = #{sessionKey} ORDER BY m.chat_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (session_key, from_user_id, to_user_id, goods_id, content, message_type, related_id, is_read, create_time) VALUES (#{sessionKey}, #{fromUserId}, #{toUserId}, #{goodsId}, #{content}, #{messageType}, #{relatedId}, #{isRead}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message WHERE to_user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
